_comment: 2026-07-26 main-quest restructure (Task 2.4 follow-up, controller ruling on the three-pillars gate): THE NON-FIGHT BREACH canonical. horns_dig's `breach` beat promises 'fight what guards it, walk the plates, or read the wardwork', but every non-fight producer of pedestal_unsealed used to sit behind the door chain -- which since the restructure does not start until AFTER this pedestal is open -- so the beat shipped FIGHT-ONLY. This script is the live proof that it no longer does: from horns_dig_plates_start (camp joined, nothing else banked, no [Detect Magic] in the build) it presses the plinth for its locked flavour arm, walks the shipped ordered plate pair (near then far), presses the plinth again -- which now BANKS pedestal_unsealed off the new dig-gated variant -- and opens the pedestal to the reveal. THE NEGATIVE PROOF is the whole-run combat_started absence: the guardian is standing at (17,8) the entire time (the fixture removes nothing) and is never fought. The FIGHT leg stays horns_dig_flow's own subject; the [Detect Magic] wardwork leg is proven at sim level in test_sim_core.gd (both legs cannot share one run -- whichever fires first banks pedestal_unsealed and the other stops being reachable). Cell route is door_chain_talk's own proven plate walk, minus its wrong-order leg (that can-fail is that script's subject, not this one's). Seed 9 for convention; the fixture resolves no combat, so rng governs nothing.

steps._comment: Move down to the 'Continue' row, confirm loads the horns_dig_plates_start manual slot.

== THE SEAL, STILL SHUT ==. Bump SOUTH into the plinth's own (blocked) cell (17,6) for facing. contains_when needs pedestal_unsealed + rune_sequence_done, both unbanked, so the interact falls through to the plinth's flavour arm -- and the NEW plates variant is unsatisfied too (no rune_sequence_done yet), which is what makes this step the can-fail sentinel for the ordering: if the variant fired here the seal would open before the puzzle was walked.

payload_contains.text: The stone doesn't move. It does not even shift in its cradle, and the court has gone very quiet.

steps._comment: == THE PLATES ==. NEAR plate (16,6) first: west one cell to (16,5), then bump south into it.
FAR plate (15,4) second: west to (15,5), bump north into it. Its variant fires only because the near plate is lit -- the shipped b10 #204 ordering, unchanged by this task.

== THE BREACH, WITHOUT A FIGHT ==. Back east to (17,5) and bump south into the plinth again. Both spirals lit and the camp joined, so the new dig-gated variant resolves and BANKS pedestal_unsealed -- the beat's 'walk the plates' route, live.

payload_contains.text: Both spirals hold their light, and the seam under the plinth stops fighting your hand. The ward wanted the plates walked in order, and now they have been. Ceria, already reaching for rope: 'Ksmvr. Down. Carefully.'

steps._comment: == THE REVEAL ==. contains_when is met now, so the very next interact routes to the CONTAINER instead of any variant, and its ARRAY on_open_accomplishment banks the convergent set -- the identical reveal horns_dig_flow reaches through the guardian.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: Below the pedestal: not treasure. A door, unhung, unmarked, utterly ordinary except that four adventurers go silent around it at once. Ceria, finally: 'That's wardwork. Old, fed wardwork. We're taking it home.' The anchor stone comes up with it.

steps._comment: THE NEGATIVE PROOF, whole-run: the breach beat completed with the ruin_guardian still standing. Nothing in this script ever entered combat, and the guardian's own victory counter never banked -- the beat is no longer fight-only.
